restoration_note: The teaching gives a structural anatomy of the Lord's outgoing toward the soul: the Five Greatnesses (Father of Greatness, Mother of Life with the Five Sons of First Man, Living Spirit/Great Builder with his five sons, Third Ambassador with the Pillar of Glory and powers of light, Jesus the Radiance with his emanations) folded into the twelve aeons (with the Call and Hearing as the Father-and-Mother conjugate). The arc then drops through the judicial parable (the noble man surrounded by enemies; the King's pure judge sent against the violence; sentencing in righteousness binding each archon according to its measure) and onward through Jesus the Radiance binding the bitter trees and planting good ones, reaching the molding of Adam and Eve. The closing similitude of the hot stone in milk pictures the Call and Answer at consummation. Gap restorations were tightly constrained for editor-confirmed onsets/finals and for formulaic structural items (Five/Twelve, Father+Mother+Living Spirit triad, righteousness/judgment/sentencing pairs, Call+Hearing). Many medium gaps in fragmented sections (16.105–127, 16.135–142, 16.194–205) were left unrestored where no formula or trace fixed them.
